Spectral sensitivity for a named species and photoreceptor class.

Source: R/species_perception.R
species_LEF.Rd

Looks up peak wavelength and chromophore from the bundled species_sensitivities table, then applies the Govardovskii (2000) template to return a normalised sensitivity curve.

Usage

species_LEF(species, receptor = NULL, lambda = seq(300, 700, by = 1))

Arguments

species

Species name (character). Must match a row in species_sensitivities$species. Case-sensitive.

receptor

Photoreceptor class (e.g. "L-cone", "rod"). If NULL (default), returns all receptor classes as a named list.

lambda

Wavelength grid in nm. Default seq(300, 700, by = 1).

Value

A data frame (single receptor) or named list of data frames (all receptors). Each data frame has columns lambda and S.

Examples

species_LEF("Homo sapiens", receptor = "L-cone")
